ethnicity.evidence_source: [011_22_statistical_analyses] The present study used data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP), a nationally representative longitudinal study of private households in Germany (Wagner, Frick, & Schupp, 2007). The SOEP started in 1984 and has since surveyed the same households and individuals annually. For the present study, we used data from 1984 to 2014. We focused on the subsample of individuals who were between 17 and 85 years old in 1984 and participated in at least two waves. The final sample consisted of 14,893 individuals (52% women) with a total of 198,765 observations.
